CREATE TABLE ai_runs (
	purpose VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	model VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	prompt_version VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	input_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	input_tokens INTEGER, 
	output_tokens INTEGER, 
	cached_tokens INTEGER, 
	output_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	approval_state VARCHAR(14) NOT NULL, 
	approved_at DATETIME, 
	error TEXT, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE audit_events (
	occurred_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	entity_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	entity_id VARCHAR(100), 
	before_json JSON, 
	after_json JSON, 
	detail TEXT, 
	correlation_id VARCHAR(100), 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_audit_entity_time ON audit_events (entity_type, entity_id, occurred_at);

CREATE TABLE companies (
	name VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	normalized_name VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	website TEXT, 
	notes TEXT, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_companies_normalized_name ON companies (normalized_name);

CREATE TABLE import_reviews (
	workspace_root TEXT NOT NULL, 
	source_path TEXT NOT NULL, 
	record_key VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	raw_excerpt TEXT, 
	proposed_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(9) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_import_review_record UNIQUE (workspace_root, source_path, record_key)
);

CREATE TABLE integration_states (
	provider VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	account_hint VARCHAR(300), 
	scopes JSON NOT NULL, 
	last_sync_at DATETIME, 
	health VARCHAR(100), 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (provider)
);

CREATE TABLE legacy_seen_identifiers (
	workspace_root TEXT NOT NULL, 
	source_uid VARCHAR(700) NOT NULL, 
	imported_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	legacy_last_run VARCHAR(100), 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_legacy_seen_workspace_uid UNIQUE (workspace_root, source_uid)
);

CREATE TABLE locations (
	display_name VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	normalized_key VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	city VARCHAR(200), 
	region VARCHAR(200), 
	country VARCHAR(100), 
	remote BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_locations_normalized_key ON locations (normalized_key);

CREATE TABLE scan_runs (
	status VARCHAR(9) NOT NULL, 
	"query" TEXT, 
	requested_sources JSON NOT NULL, 
	source_results JSON NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME, 
	finished_at DATETIME, 
	discovered_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	error_summary TEXT, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE source_configs (
	import_key VARCHAR(64), 
	provider VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	config_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_source_configs_import_key ON source_configs (import_key);

CREATE TABLE agent_runs (
	status VARCHAR(9) NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME, 
	finished_at DATETIME, 
	scan_run_id VARCHAR(36), 
	summary JSON NOT NULL, 
	error TEXT, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scan_run_id) REFERENCES scan_runs (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);

CREATE TABLE citations (
	ai_run_id VARCHAR(36), 
	scan_run_id VARCHAR(36), 
	url TEXT NOT NULL, 
	title TEXT, 
	quoted_text TEXT, 
	start_index INTEGER, 
	end_index INTEGER, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(ai_run_id) REFERENCES ai_runs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(scan_run_id) REFERENCES scan_runs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE contacts (
	company_id VARCHAR(36), 
	name VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(500), 
	title VARCHAR(300), 
	linkedin_url TEXT, 
	notes TEXT, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);

CREATE TABLE jobs (
	company_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	location_id VARCHAR(36), 
	title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	normalized_title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	canonical_url TEXT, 
	source_primary VARCHAR(80), 
	source_id VARCHAR(500), 
	description TEXT, 
	description_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	status VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	remote_status VARCHAR(40), 
	compensation_text TEXT, 
	salary_min INTEGER, 
	salary_max INTEGER, 
	salary_currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, 
	posted_at DATETIME, 
	deadline DATE, 
	discovered_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	last_seen_at DATETIME, 
	closed_at DATETIME, 
	consecutive_misses INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	explicit_closure BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	liveness_known BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	latest_score FLOAT, 
	category VARCHAR(100), 
	notes TEXT, 
	manual_status_locked BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_job_source_id UNIQUE (source_primary, source_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(location_id) REFERENCES locations (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);
CREATE INDEX ix_jobs_status_score ON jobs (status, latest_score);

CREATE TABLE applications (
	job_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	current_stage VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	submission_channel VARCHAR(200), 
	submitted_at DATETIME, 
	follow_up_at DATETIME, 
	rejection_reason TEXT, 
	notes TEXT, 
	import_key VARCHAR(64), 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_applications_import_key ON applications (import_key);

CREATE TABLE document_versions (
	kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	parent_id VARCHAR(36), 
	job_id VARCHAR(36), 
	content_markdown TEXT NOT NULL, 
	content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	approval_state VARCHAR(14) NOT NULL, 
	is_canonical BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	provenance JSON NOT NULL, 
	diff_data JSON NOT NULL, 
	validation JSON NOT NULL, 
	ai_run_id VARCHAR(36), 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(parent_id) REFERENCES document_versions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(ai_run_id) REFERENCES ai_runs (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);
CREATE INDEX ix_documents_kind_canonical ON document_versions (kind, is_canonical);

CREATE TABLE duplicate_relationships (
	job_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	duplicate_job_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	rule VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	similarity FLOAT, 
	confirmed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_duplicate_pair UNIQUE (job_id, duplicate_job_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(duplicate_job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE evaluations (
	job_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	components JSON NOT NULL, 
	gates JSON NOT NULL, 
	evidence JSON NOT NULL, 
	warnings JSON NOT NULL, 
	explanation TEXT, 
	confidence FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	automatic_skip BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	manual_override BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	locked BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	is_current BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	ai_run_id VARCHAR(36), 
	import_key VARCHAR(64), 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(ai_run_id) REFERENCES ai_runs (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_evaluation_job_current ON evaluations (job_id) WHERE is_current = 1;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_evaluations_import_key ON evaluations (import_key);

CREATE TABLE legacy_metrics (
	import_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	rubric VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	metric_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	value FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	scale_min FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	scale_max FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	source_path TEXT NOT NULL, 
	raw_text TEXT, 
	imported_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_legacy_metrics_import_key ON legacy_metrics (import_key);

CREATE TABLE source_observations (
	job_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	import_key VARCHAR(64), 
	scan_run_id VARCHAR(36), 
	source VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	source_account VARCHAR(200), 
	source_job_id VARCHAR(500), 
	source_url TEXT, 
	title_snapshot VARCHAR(500), 
	company_snapshot VARCHAR(500), 
	location_snapshot VARCHAR(500), 
	observed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	is_live BOOLEAN, 
	closure_evidence TEXT, 
	content_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	raw_payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_observation_run_source_job UNIQUE (scan_run_id, source, source_job_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(scan_run_id) REFERENCES scan_runs (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);
CREATE INDEX ix_observation_job_observed ON source_observations (job_id, observed_at);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_source_observations_import_key ON source_observations (import_key);

CREATE TABLE alerts (
	severity VARCHAR(7) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	message TEXT NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR(36), 
	application_id VARCHAR(36), 
	acknowledged_at DATETIME, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES applications (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE application_materials (
	application_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	document_version_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	used_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_application_material_purpose UNIQUE (application_id, document_version_id, purpose), 
	FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES applications (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_version_id) REFERENCES document_versions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);

CREATE TABLE artifacts (
	kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	workspace_root TEXT, 
	source_path TEXT, 
	stored_path TEXT, 
	content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	mime_type VARCHAR(200), 
	source_mtime_ns INTEGER, 
	source_immutable BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	document_version_id VARCHAR(36), 
	job_id VARCHAR(36), 
	metadata_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_artifact_source_version UNIQUE (workspace_root, source_path, content_hash), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_version_id) REFERENCES document_versions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);

CREATE TABLE email_messages (
	provider_message_id VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	sender TEXT, 
	subject TEXT, 
	received_at DATETIME, 
	snippet TEXT, 
	application_id VARCHAR(36), 
	full_body_retrieved BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (provider_message_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES applications (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);

CREATE TABLE interviews (
	application_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	starts_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	ends_at DATETIME, 
	interview_type VARCHAR(100), 
	location_or_link TEXT, 
	contact_id VARCHAR(36), 
	notes TEXT, 
	calendar_event_id VARCHAR(500), 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES applications (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(contact_id) REFERENCES contacts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	UNIQUE (calendar_event_id)
);

CREATE TABLE offers (
	application_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	base_salary FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	annual_bonus FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	annualized_equity FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, 
	cost_of_living_index FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	stress_score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	terms JSON NOT NULL, 
	decision VARCHAR(100), 
	offered_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES applications (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
CREATE INDEX ix_offers_application_decision ON offers (application_id, decision);

CREATE TABLE stage_events (
	application_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	from_stage VARCHAR(10), 
	to_stage VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT, 
	actor VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES applications (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
CREATE INDEX ix_stage_events_application_time ON stage_events (application_id, occurred_at);

CREATE TABLE tasks (
	title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	status VARCHAR(9) NOT NULL, 
	due_at DATETIME, 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	job_id VARCHAR(36), 
	application_id VARCHAR(36), 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES applications (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
CREATE INDEX ix_tasks_status_due ON tasks (status, due_at);

CREATE TABLE external_suggestions (
	kind VARCHAR(19) NOT NULL, 
	application_id VARCHAR(36), 
	email_message_id VARCHAR(36), 
	external_event_id VARCHAR(500), 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	confidence FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	approval_state VARCHAR(14) NOT NULL, 
	applied_at DATETIME, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES applications (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(email_message_id) REFERENCES email_messages (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE profile_facts (
	fact_key VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	value_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	approved BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	approved_at DATETIME, 
	source_artifact_id VARCHAR(36), 
	content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_artifact_id) REFERENCES artifacts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_profile_facts_fact_key ON profile_facts (fact_key);
